verdict.rationale: Windows developer docs offer a way to "explore controls, inspect working code" for Windows apps, which is a thin first-party sign of interactive, code-backed exploration of the UI controls surface. There is no evidence of a full interactive API reference with runnable, try-it examples, and the OpenAPI probe found no machine-readable API spec. Missing for 10: a documented interactive API reference covering the platform APIs, in-browser or runnable examples beyond control samples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
